prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String resolvePolicy(String path, String key, Map<String,Map<String,String>> rules)
Behavior: The requested path and every rule-path key must be absolute. Normalize trailing slashes except root before lookup. Reject the entire input when two distinct raw rule paths normalize to the same path. The requested key must match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. The nearest exact key wins; '*' is fallback only at the same path. Return DENY when no rule exists.
Visible example: rules /a/b|read=ALLOW and /a|*=DENY make /a/b/c read ALLOW and write DENY.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String resolvePolicy(String p,String k,Map<String,Map<String,String>>r){if(!k.matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||!p.startsWith("/"))return null;var clean=new HashMap<String,Map<String,String>>();for(var e:r.entrySet()){if(!e.getKey().startsWith("/"))return null;String n=e.getKey().replaceAll("/+$","");if(n.isEmpty())n="/";if(clean.putIfAbsent(n,e.getValue())!=null)return null;}p=p.replaceAll("/+$","");if(p.isEmpty())p="/";for(;;){var x=clean.getOrDefault(p,Map.of());if(x.containsKey(k))return x.get(k);if(x.containsKey("*"))return x.get("*");if(p.equals("/"))return "DENY";p=p.substring(0,p.lastIndexOf("/"));if(p.isEmpty())p="/";}}}
